description:
Goal
The telemetry arc is complete only when every handler derives presentation data from raw authority references and the full suite proves that contract. Emitters remain lazy and pass minimal borrowed authorities; handlers that retain data copy it themselves.

Baseline proof
On fz-1ah/integration at ca59b76ac, source_publication_defers_local_macro_expansion_until_function_demand fails because the macro-expanded test still expects input_heap_id/output_heap_id/input_root_ref scalar measurements that the raw-reference emitter removed. compiler2_notes_top_level_types_into_the_global_scope and protocol-domain telemetry likewise still expect copied name strings instead of reading opaque TypeName/World authority. These failures predate fz-k22.23 and must not be hidden in its callable-model changes.

Strategy
Inventory all compiler2 telemetry emitters and handlers. Remove emitter-side id/name/count/render transformations and redundant fields; pass the smallest raw borrowed authorities, preferring World plus stable keys when the fact already lives in World. Update production and test handlers to derive values during the callback and copy only when retaining them. Where a test needs macro input/output heap identity, pass the raw QuotedSourceRoot/input root references rather than reconstructing scalar measurements. Delete obsolete helper accessors and copied metadata assertions.

Scope discovered by executable audit
The lazy-emitter AST guard previously parsed metadata keys but did not visit metadata or measurement value expressions. Correct traversal exposes 47 remaining projections: semantic pull/transport/dump/source/world emitters scalarize ids, counts, and product kinds, while private native-codegen emitters derive module paths and collection counts. This scope is part of this ticket. Unread projected fields are deleted. Retained semantic signals pass World plus stable keys or their raw owning objects. Retained private-codegen signals use codegen-owned projection handlers attached at the CLI telemetry configuration boundary; private authorities are not exported merely for telemetry.

Signal
The no-handler world query counters stay zero; emitter guard tests prove no eager payload work; handler tests prove retained copies are made in handlers; cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass. Release telemetry/no-telemetry fixture measurements remain within the epic performance bounds.
title: Migrate raw-authority telemetry handlers and audit event payloads
